messages.content: You are a computational biologist. Given a CRISPR screen description, produce a ranked list of 100 gene symbols (HGNC nomenclature for Homo sapiens) that you believe are MOST LIKELY to be hits in this screen, ordered strongest first. Use only your knowledge of biology — no chain-of-thought in the output. Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 symbols, no prose, no numbering.

## Goal

You are tasked with ranking genes from a genetic perturbation screen. Based on the experimental context and hit criteria provided below, provide a list of exactly 100 genes that are hits in this screen, ranked from strongest to weakest according to the criteria defined below.

## Experimental Context

This screen was performed in Calu1-ACE2 cells, a Lung Cancer Cell Line. Researchers used a CRISPRn library (Knockout) to systematically perturb gene function. The experiment followed a Virus Exposure design and was conducted over 6 Days under SARS-CoV-2 Spike‐Δ19 protein pseudotyped lentivirus treatment (25.0 %).

## Screen Objective

The primary objective of this screen was to identify a set of hit genes, each of which decreases cell viability of Calu-1 ACE2-overexpressing cells upon SARS-CoV-2 Spike-delta19 pseudotyped lentiviral infection.

## Hit Definition

A gene is classified as a "hit" if its Knockout significantly decreases cell viability of Calu-1 ACE2-overexpressing cells upon SARS-CoV-2 Spike-delta19 pseudotyped lentiviral infection. The statistical criterion for significance is: Log2FC < 0.0 AND FDR < 0.05.

## Ranking Criteria

Genes with low Log2FC, low FDR are ranked most highly.

## Additional Context
Screen notes: A CRISPR/Cas9 genome-wide screen was carried out to identify novel host factors for SARS-CoV-2 entry.  A cellular model was used involving Calu-1 cells overexpressing ACE2 and a SARS-CoV-2 Spike-delta 19 protein pseudotyped lentivirus

## Required Output Format

Provide your response as an ordered list of exactly 100 HGNC gene symbols, using the ranking criteria above.
That is, top genes should have low Log2FC, low FDR.

Format: 
GENE1, GENE2, GENE3, ..., GENE100

=== Final instruction ===
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 gene symbols (no prose, no numbers, no markdown). All gene symbols must use the HGNC convention for Homo sapiens (e.g. 'TP53' for HGNC, 'Trp53' for MGI). Do not return symbols from another organism.
